tips.text: Bring any high-damage frame and speed-run Vor; he is the lowest-level boss and dies in a minute or two.
Abort and restart if Vor locks up in his first room after the second health bar; waiting does not fix it.
Check you hold 2 Orokin Cells before the foundry; having all three parts is not enough.
Expect about six kills, with the Receiver usually the last part; streaks of a dozen for one part get reported.
Players call it a mediocre pistol that is only worth building for Mastery.
